import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int add(int x, int y) {
        x += y;
        return x >= MOD ? x - MOD : x;
    }

    static int sub(int x, int y) {
        return x >= y ? x - y : x + MOD - y;
    }

    static long mul(long x, long y) {
        return x * y % MOD;
    }

    static int modPow(int b, int e) {
        int r = 1;
        while (e != 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) r = (int) mul(r, b);
            b = (int) mul(b, b);
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static int n;
    static int[][] p = new int[8][8];
    static int[][] g = new int[8][8];
    static int[][][] mask3 = new int[7][7][7];
    static int fullMask;
    static int[] dp = new int[1048576];
    static int ans;

    static boolean valid(int a, int b, int c) {
        int[] vals = {0, a, b, c};
        int[] idx = {0, 1, 2, 3};
        do {
            boolean ok = true;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; ++i) {
                if (g[idx[i]][vals[i]] == 0) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (ok) return true;
        } while (nextPermutation(idx, 1, 4));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        int i = end - 2;
        while (i >= start && array[i] >= array[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < start) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = end - 1;
        while (array[j] <= array[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        int temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
        for (int left = i + 1, right = end - 1; left < right; left++, right--) {
            temp = array[left];
            array[left] = array[right];
            array[right] = temp;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void dfs1(int cur, int r, int c) {
        if (cur == 0) return;
        if (r == 4) {
            boolean[] used = {false, true, true, true, true, true, true};
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                        if (valid(i, j, k)) {
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = false;
                            int x = -1, y = -1, z = -1;
                            for (int l = 1; l <= 6; ++l) {
                                if (!used[l]) {
                                    if (x == -1) x = l;
                                    else if (y == -1) y = l;
                                    else z = l;
                                }
                            }
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = true;
                            if (z != -1) state |= mask3[x][y][z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            dp[state] = add(dp[state], cur);
            return;
        }
        g[r][c] = 1;
        int nxt = (int) mul(cur, p[r][c]);
        if (c == 6) dfs1(nxt, r + 1, 1);
        else dfs1(nxt, r, c + 1);
        g[r][c] = 0;
        nxt = (int) mul(cur, sub(1, p[r][c]));
        if (c == 6) dfs1(nxt, r + 1, 1);
        else dfs1(nxt, r, c + 1);
    }

    static void dfs2(int cur, int r, int c) {
        if (cur == 0) return;
        if (r == 7) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                        if (valid(i, j, k)) state |= mask3[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            ans = add(ans, (int) mul(cur, dp[fullMask ^ state]));
            return;
        }
        g[r - 3][c] = 1;
        int nxt = (int) mul(cur, p[r][c]);
        if (c == 6) dfs2(nxt, r + 1, 1);
        else dfs2(nxt, r, c + 1);
        g[r - 3][c] = 0;
        nxt = (int) mul(cur, sub(1, p[r][c]));
        if (c == 6) dfs2(nxt, r + 1, 1);
        else dfs2(nxt, r, c + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int inv100 = modPow(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                int x = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = (int) mul(x, inv100);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; ++i) p[i][i] = 1;
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                    mask3[i][j][k] = 1 << cnt;
                    ++cnt;
                }
            }
        }
        fullMask = (1 << cnt) - 1;
        dfs1(1, 1, 1);
        int total = 1 << cnt;
        for (int b = 0; b < cnt; ++b) {
            for (int m = 0; m < total; ++m) {
                if ((m & (1 << b)) != 0) {
                    dp[m] = add(dp[m], dp[m ^ (1 << b)]);
                }
            }
        }
        ans = 0;
        dfs2(1, 4, 1);
        ans = sub(1, ans);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
